ticker.text: Ricky Pearsall to miss all of 2026 — PCL surgery, season-ending IR
Zach Charbonnet lands on reserve/PUP — out a minimum of 4 games
Shane Steichen missed Saturday's Colts practice — personal matter, expected back

items.text: Chiefs rookie WR Cyrus Allen was carted off Saturday after colliding with CB Kaiir Elam on a special-teams drill — tests came back a shin bruise, nothing torn or broken
Bills S C.J. Gardner-Johnson pulled up non-contact in Saturday 11-on-11s grabbing his right lower leg; reported as a calf strain, no serious damage
Malik Nabers will NOT open on PUP — running routes at full speed at Giants camp and on track for Week 1, which removes the biggest discount on his ADP
Panthers RB Jonathon Brooks continues to take first-team reps with Dave Canales talking him up, per Mike Kaye — shaping into a 1-2 punch with Chuba Hubbard (ongoing)
Eagles EDGE Jonathan Greenard opened camp on PUP with a pec strain suffered lifting; the team does not expect it to be long-term
Seahawks S Nick Emmanwori also opened camp on PUP following offseason ankle surgery — roughly 40 players leaguewide started 2026 camp on PUP/NFI/IR
HC Shane Steichen was absent from Saturday's Day 4 practice due to a personal matter and skipped his scheduled media session; the team expects him back soon, per Kevin Bowen
Rookie S A.J. Haulcy took the starting strong-safety reps Saturday after Hunter Wohler was stretched out on the sideline early and did not return — first flip in that battle
Backup RB race heating up: DJ Giddens and 7th-rounder Seth McGowan both broke off touchdown runs Saturday; McGowan is firmly in the mix behind Jonathan Taylor, per Kevin Bowen
Riley Leonard took the bulk of second-team reps for the first time (4-of-8, rushing TD, 50-yard bomb to Westbrook-Ikhine) while Anthony Richardson Sr. went 1-of-4, per Horseshoe Huddle
WR Alec Pierce still has not practiced — Horseshoe Huddle lists ankle, 1075 The Fan lists calf and PUP; DT Derrick Nnadi and CB Cameron Mitchell also sat Saturday (ongoing)
Colts are off Sunday; first full-padded practice is Monday 8/3, with a joint practice at New England 8/11 and the preseason opener there 8/13
